items.title: Scientists find hidden materials that could improve batteries and solar fuels

items.title: A quantum prediction from 1931 just came to life
items.summary_raw: Nearly a century after physicist Hans Bethe predicted them, scientists have created and directly observed unusual quantum states known as “Bethe strings” in an ultracold gas. By cooling cesium atoms to near absolute zero and trapping them in thousands of tiny one-dimensional tubes, researchers were able to make groups of atoms bind together without ordinary chemical bonds. These strange clusters could contain six or more particles and even collide with one another without falling apart.

items.title: Scientists found Homo erectus 200,000 years earlier than expected
items.summary_raw: New fossils from South Africa are reshaping the story of early human evolution. The finds also reveal that Paranthropus robustus, which lived alongside Homo erectus, was gradually evolving even larger teeth and stronger chewing muscles as the climate changed.
